_meta.source: Hong Kong Citybus / NWFB (新巴/城巴) public fare tables. Head (max) fare per single ride, adult Octopus-card price. After the 2023 CTB+NWFB merger both operators use the Citybus fare scale. https://www.citybus.com.hk/
_meta.note: Flat fare per route — CTB does not publish per-stop fare data publicly, so the route-detail screen renders the same single fare on every stop row. Keys are the route numbers; values include the operator 'CTB' or 'NWFB' so the helper can fall back correctly. Routes not in this table render no fare pill.
